text:
Predicates:
MusicPiece(x) ::: x is a music piece.
Composer(x) ::: x writes music pieces.
Premieres(x, y) ::: x premiered y.
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Conductor(x) ::: x is a conductor.
Premises:
MusicPiece(symphonyNo9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
∀x (Composer(x) → MusicPiece(x)) ::: Composers write music pieces.
Composer(beethoven) ∧ MusicPiece(symphonyNo9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Premieres(viennaMusicSociety, symphonyNo9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Leads(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
∀x (Orchestra(x) → ∃y (Conductor(y) ∧ Leads(y, x))) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
Conclusion:
∃x ∃y (Orchestra(x) ∧ Premieres(x, y)) ::: Some orchestras premiered music pieces.
